title: Rezoning map change for 135-27 Sapphire Street, Queens
summary: This resolution approves changing the zoning of 135-27 Sapphire Street in Queens from R4 to R6A, allowing a new six-story residential building of about 186,380 square feet. The project would create roughly 268 apartments, including about 67 permanently income-restricted units under Mandatory Inclusionary Housing. The City Planning Commission's decision was reviewed at a public hearing on September 23, 2026.
